title: Fix `AnimatableBody2D` cannot move with parent when `sync_to_physics=true`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/54915*
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/58269*
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/63140*
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/76685*
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/82373*
- *https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98970*

It is not a easy issue. I create this PR for giving a demo to discuss how to solve this issue.

This MRP comes from #58269 , updated to 4.5 version.
[AnimatableBodyTest45.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22921186/AnimatableBodyTest45.zip)

**Issue Description**

There are three scenarios about this issue.

- Using AnimationPlayer to play an animation. e.g. an moving platform.
- PathFollow. e.g. moving follows a curve path.
- Collission. e.g. carry a box with platform and move. **NO JITTER**

**Investigation**

Current `AnimationBody2D` is `StaticBody2D`, it supports collision. And `AnimationPlayer` can modify the the position of `AnimationBody2D` or its parent node.

When `sync_to_physics=true` by default, the hack operation is listen a `NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED` which means current node transform had been updated. It is a specific event, considering it occur only once. When current node position update, `AnimatableBody2D` first update the position to `PhysicsServer`, and revert to position before update, then listen to `PhysicsServer` to callback after collision. I think this might be more accurate for `PhysicsServer` to compute the final position of `StaticBody2D`?

Here we cannot use `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED`, as this events occurs more than once. If we used it to update `PhysicsServer` then revert. The next event will re-send the reverted position to `PhysicsServer` again.

But without `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED`, the child node cannot get when parent node moved, and cannot update the position of PhysicsServer. That causes collision broken.

**Solution**

First, we need a new notification to notice child nodes when their parent moved. This event should be triggered only once, likes `NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED`. I created a `NOTIFICATION_PARENT_TRANSFORM_CHANGED` and noticed it in `canvas_item`.

Second, listen `NOTIFICATION_PARENT_TRANSFORM_CHANGED` in `AnimatableBody2D` as `NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED`, and only with `sync_to_physics=true` to prevent it freeze node when `sync_to_physics=false`.

Third, there are still some JITTER, I find it caused by the PhysicsServer callback didn't always be invoked before every `process` iteration, so add additional `PhysicsServer2D::get_singleton()->flush_queries();` in `main.cpp`.

**Etc**

In MRP, I cannot find out the different from `sync_to_physics=true` to `sync_to_physics=false`, Why we need `sync_to_physics=true`? Is there any scenario that `sync_to_physics=false` cannot handle?
